chunks: From him, from al-Nakhaʿī, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: Indeed, I perform the supererogatory tawaf while I am without wudu (ablution). He said: Perform wudu (ablution) and pray, even if you did so deliberately.

key_terms.طَوَافَ النَّافِلَةِ: supererogatory circumambulation, meaning a non-obligatory tawaf
key_terms.غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ: without wudu (ablution), in a state lacking ritual ablution

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they performed a supererogatory tawaf without wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing a supererogatory tawaf without wudu (ablution). The Imam عليه السلام instructs that one should perform wudu (ablution) and then pray, including in the case where it was done deliberately.
